title: Part
spec: Start by setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, create a two-dimensional sketch on the X-Y plane. In this sketch, draw the first face, which consists of a rectangular loop. Begin with the first line starting at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending at (0.0057, 0.0). Draw the second line from (0.0057, 0.0) to (0.0057, 0.0086), followed by the third line from (0.0057, 0.0086) to (0.0, 0.0086). Finally, complete the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0086) back to the origin. After drawing the rectangle, apply a scale factor of 0.0086 to the entire sketch. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will create a solid body with a length of 0.0057 meters, a width of 0.00855 meters, and a height of 0.75 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0057, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0057, 0.0086) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0086) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder with a rectangular protrusion
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
